notes.title: Hello!
notes.notes:
Rumors that our entire team fell into a cryo-sleep before 2322 are greatly exaggerated! We are cheerful, cheerful and work tirelessly with hands, feet, keyboards, brushes and paints!
And here are the proofs.
The "Bunker" has released the biggest update of all that the game has ever had.
Now you can read the story of Mei waking up in the world after the end of the world to the very end. Bam! Pun intended!)

[h1]All branches, all endings, all characters, all art. It's all here. Everything is for you, as a popular singer sang.
Well, the achievements, of course. Where without them. I know you love them. So, they are now there. In the amount of eight pieces. Not so much to collect them all. I believe in you![/h1]

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
100% of all achievements, plot and locations are available.
Fixed bugs, fixed the interface.

notes.title: Something went wrong with the cryo capsule!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
Something went wrong and the cryocapsule, in which our main character spent many years, still does not want to open.. 
In this regard, the release is postponed to the end of April.
Don't lose, don't get bored, believe! ːsteamhappyː
